# Three.js

Pinned version: 0.160.1. Local classic-script bundle used for compatibility with this buildless portfolio and its file:// preview.

Source: https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.1/build/three.min.js

MIT license retained in LICENSE. No runtime CDN dependency.

The original procedural Nex meshes are defined in ../../nex-scene.js. The existing raster illustrations remain as a static fallback when WebGL is unavailable; they are not used as rotating planes.
